title: Baked Fish Fingers with Sweet Potato Wedges
blurb: Crispy coated fish strips and golden sweet potato wedges baked together on one tray
steps: Heat your oven to 220°C and line a large baking sheet with parchment paper.
Peel the sweet potatoes and cut them into wedges about 1cm thick, then toss with half the oil and a pinch of salt on one half of the prepared tray.
Cut the cod into finger-width strips and pat them dry with kitchen paper.
Set up three shallow dishes: flour with seasoning in the first, lightly beaten egg whites in the second, and breadcrumbs mixed with the remaining oil in the third.
Coat each fish strip in flour, then egg white, then breadcrumbs, and arrange them on the other half of the tray.
Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, turning the sweet potato wedges halfway through, until the fish is golden and the wedges are tender.
Serve with light mayonnaise and lemon wedges for squeezing over.
